AHU-07 running status alone does not confirm adequate cooling at Floor 7 terminals.
When AHU supply-air temperature is normal, investigate VAV zone airflow and damper feedback.

# Synthetic Floor 7 maintenance record: AHU-07 and VAV-7E-14

This historical incident does not establish the cause of the current Floor 7 temperature increase.

full.question: Why is Floor 7 getting warmer even though AHU-07 is running?

Review maintenance records and time-aligned trends before confirming a root cause.
